titulo: About | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › About About GTA 6 Encyclopedia An independent GTA 6 encyclopedia, in English and Spanish. What it is GTA 6 Encyclopedia brings together guides, characters, the map, vehicles, weapons, missions and cheats for Grand Theft Auto VI, set in the fictional state of Leonida. It is available in English and Spanish. How we label every fact Every fact carries a label (Official or Unconfirmed) so you know how well it is confirmed. Details are in the verification policy . Independence We are an independent fan site, not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of its respective owners. Transparency We may include advertising and affiliate links. If present, they will be clearly marked and do not influence what we publish or the confirmation labels. Contact Found a mistake or want to suggest content? Write to us at contacto@gta6encyclopedia.com . Scope of independence This project does not represent the developers or publisher. Game and trademark names are used only to identify the subject of the guides. See the legal notice for the scope of this statement. How we work after launch Entries are completed using reproducible in-game testing. When information depends on platform, version, mode or progression, those details will be stated. We correct or remove entries when new evidence contradicts a previous publication.

How to get it Official GTA 6 achievements FAQ How many achievements does GTA 6 have? 55 in total: 54 achievements worth 1,000G on Xbox Series X|S and, on PS5, 54 trophies plus the platinum. The list is the same on both consoles. What's the hardest achievement? A Long Road (100% completion). The Shootist (every shooting range gold) and Cunning Stunts (250 stunts) also take a while. Are there missable achievements? Possibly one: Positive Mental Attitude , because of the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house. Everything else can be done after the story. How long does it take to get them all? Around 200 hours. See the platinum guide for the recommended order. Do cheats block achievements? Yes: while a cheat is on, achievements don't unlock and you can't save in that session. Are there online achievements? No. They're all story mode.

titulo: A Classic Blitz Play: how to get the GTA 6 trophy and achievement | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › Achievements and trophies › A Classic Blitz Play A Classic Blitz Play Rob an armored truck and escape. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? A Classic Blitz Play PS5 trophy Bronze Xbox achievement 10G Hidden No Missable No Rob an armored truck and escape. Official How to get it When: Chapter 4 or earlier, with sticky bombs. It pops on its own in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since a large vault robbery counts. To get it earlier: block an armored truck, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and escape the red zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are sold at Yasmani's shop after his jobs. Useful pages How to make money Crime and heist trophies Hot Together (bronze): With Jason and Lucia together, lose a 4-star wanted level and get out of the red zone. Retail Therapy (bronze): With your partner, rob three shops back to back without losing your wanted level. Sneakthief (bronze): Finish Yasmani's jewelry jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies. Maximum Withdrawal (silver): First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. Pest Control (bronze): Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs (there are 39 in total). Dime on the Dollar (bronze): The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Let's Go Bowling (bronze): Do the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. On PS5 and Xbox On PS5 it is a bronze trophy; on Xbox Series X|S it is a 10G achievement. It unlocks exactly the same way on both consoles and every trophy is single-player. More in Achievements and trophies PS5 trophies Xbox achievements Platinum guide

titulo: A Long Road: how to get the GTA 6 trophy and achievement | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › Achievements and trophies › A Long Road A Long Road Reach 100% completion. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? A Long Road PS5 trophy Gold Xbox achievement 100G Hidden No Missable No Reach 100% completion. Official How to get it When: After finishing the story. It's the hardest one: it needs the 100% checklist, which opens once the story is done (Progress › Stats › 100%). Requirements include scanning 200 of 277 vehicles with WAiNK, studying 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges. You also need every shooting range gold medal, every drone race and 15 completed card sets. Budget around 100 hours for this trophy alone. Useful pages 100% checklist Collectible cards guide Challenges Completion trophies Vice Got a Price! (platinum): Earn the other 54 trophies. Cunning Stunts (silver): Do 250 of the map's 397 stunts. There are four types: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The Shootist (silver): Get gold in all 42 challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. Top Fun (bronze): Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One Last Thing (bronze): Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (Progress › Challenges). You WAiNKer! (silver): Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up and R1). Whip It Good (bronze): Scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK (hold Up and R1). You don't need to drive them. On PS5 and Xbox On PS5 it is a gold trophy; on Xbox Series X|S it is a 100G achievement. It unlocks exactly the same way on both consoles and every trophy is single-player. texto: Home › Achievements and trophies › Actions Speak Louder Actions Speak Louder Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Actions Speak Louder PS5 trophy Bronze Xbox achievement 5G Hidden Yes Missable No Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Official How to get it When: Throughout the game. Do 500 actions that change your criminal profile; the count shows when you select the trophy. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings to see each one. It usually comes naturally. If you're short at the end, running over civilians and cops adds up fast. Miscellaneous trophies Master of None (bronze): Try each of the nine activities once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, sinking a basketball shot, an arcade game, winning a race and doing a stunt. Earn Cash, Not Kudos (bronze): Win 20 different races out of the 40 on the map. Stick Fiddler (bronze): Finish an arcade game. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around the map. Gunslinger (bronze): Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). In The Beginning… (bronze): Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar in Ocean Beach. Personal Best (bronze): Max out both Jason's and Lucia's strength (check under Touchpad › Jason & Lucia › Strength). Bad Luck, I Guess (bronze): How to unlock it isn't confirmed yet. On PS5 and Xbox On PS5 it is a bronze trophy; on Xbox Series X|S it is a 5G achievement. It unlocks exactly the same way on both consoles and every trophy is single-player. titulo: GTA 6 platinum guide | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › Achievements and trophies › Platinum guide GTA 6 platinum guide Full list with requirements and tips. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Vice Got a Price! Platinum / 0G. Earn every other trophy. How to get it Official Recommended roadmap Play the story (60–80 h). Scan vehicles, study animals and rob shops as you go. Do the meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1: it is the only missable (Positive Mental Attitude). Save manually at the start of every chapter and before the final mission: there is no mission replay. After the credits, finish the 100% checklist (about 200 h total): robberies, 8 vaults, 39 operations, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drones and Bret. Finish with Strangers & Freaks (8 strands), the questlines with their own trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret) and the misc trophies. Do not use cheats on your main save: they disable trophies and saving. Key facts Difficulty Medium; the 100% is the long part Estimated time About 200 hours Missable trophies 1 (Positive Mental Attitude) Online trophies 0 100% checklist All 55 trophies by type There are 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze. All of them are single-player and none need online play. Story trophies (12) Just Like Paradise (bronze) · Paradise Lost (bronze) · T**s Ass Drug Money (bronze) · Vice City, Baby! Official Mandy One of Brian’s tenants (Pipework). Official Questions about the characters Is Cal Brian's son? No. Rockstar introduces Cal Hampton as Jason's friend and a fellow associate of Brian Heder, not his son. Brian is Jason's landlord and boss in the Leonida Keys; Cal works around his business and is the conspiracy-minded friend who spends his days listening in on Coast Guard radio. Who is Brian Heder? A veteran drug runner in the Leonida Keys. He lets Jason live rent-free in one of his properties in exchange for jobs. Who is Brian's wife? Lori Heder, his third wife. She appears alongside Brian, Jason and Lucia. Is Cal playable? No. The only playable characters are Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

Every GTA 6 cheat in one list: money, infinite ammo, vehicles and filters, with the D-pad code for PS5 and Xbox and the unlock requirement for each. Quick answer GTA 6 has 61 cheats ; 19 codes are known so far and the rest are added as they're confirmed. Entering the code isn't enough: each cheat is unlocked by meeting a requirement (most of them by finishing the story). You enter them on the D-pad from the phone, so the code is the same on PS5 and Xbox . The money cheat gives $250,000, but while cheats are on you can't save or earn trophies. Yes: it gives $250,000 and unlocks when you finish the story (↑ → ↓ ← ↑ ← ↓ →). But since you can't save with cheats on, that money doesn't stay in your normal save. For real money, see the money guide . Do cheats disable trophies? Yes. While a cheat is on, trophies, achievements and saving are disabled for the rest of that session. Save first and use cheats in a separate session. Why isn't a cheat working? Most often it isn't unlocked yet: each cheat has its own requirement. Also check you took out the phone first and are holding L1/LB while pressing R1/RB. Do GTA 5 cheats work? No. Neither GTA 5 button codes nor phone numbers work in GTA 6. Is there an invincibility cheat? It isn't in the list of 61. The closest are the body armor and fall-damage immunity cheats. Are they the same on PS5 and Xbox? Yes. Every code uses only the D-pad; the only difference is the button to open the list (L1+R1 on PS5, LB+RB on Xbox). texto: Home › Collectibles › Cards GTA 6 collectible cards All 18 sets and 480 cards: where to find them, what they're worth and where to sell them. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? GTA 6 collectible cards guide: all 18 sets, where to find each card, how much they sell for and which pawn shops buy them. Quick answer There are 480 cards across 18 sets . You can't buy them: they sit in fixed spots around the map. Pawn shops pay from $20 to over $1,000, and the rarest go past $2,000: the silver Ulysses Whitlock pays $2,600 and the gold Leroy Rook about $6,000. Selling a card doesn't remove it from your collection. Outdoors they're usually in yellow phone boxes on walls or in tool boxes. Use focus mode : a yellow card icon shows up when one is within reach. Yellow containers around the map can drop random cards; they count toward your collection even though guides don't list them. Some cards come in colour versions (bronze, silver, gold, red, blue, purple...). Each colour counts as a separate card. There are duplicates : they don't add to the set, but you can sell them. Check safes and lockboxes : many have the code written nearby (on a wall or a note). The bronze Laki Maivia is in a safe with code 44017. Watch out for missables : Victor Maravilla and Vicki are at the Starlet Motel and can't be picked up after Chapter 2. To track progress: Map › Progress › Collections › Collectible Cards. What cards are worth There's no fixed price per colour: each card has its own value and some sets pay more than others. Check the pawn shop's offer before you sell. These are the rough ranges the community reports: Rarity Approximate price Bronze and standard $20–$50 Silver $100–$300 (some much more) Gold $500–$1,000+ Confirmed prices Card Set Pays Where Leroy Rook (Gold) Vice City Narcos $6,000 Belville, Leonard County Ulysses Whitlock (Silver) Vice City Flamingos $2,600 Tequesta, Vice City Mateo Caballero (Silver) Vice City Flamingos $1,800 La Perle, Vice City Julian Cruz (Gold) Vice City Flamingos $800 Little Cuba, Vice City Kyle Lewicki (Teal) Vice City Narcos $115 Bayside, Vice City Marquise Bernard (Standard) Los Santos Panic $20 Key Lento, Mariana County Tip: the gold Leroy Rook is in a safe in Belville and is one of the best early paydays. More in the money guide . Where to sell your cards Pawn shops buy them. They open in Chapter 2 after the Coffee Break mission; the Hamlet one is the closest at that point. Not every shop buys everything: Vice City Pawn takes cards, doubloons and meteorites, and Pawn Stash takes cards only. On the map, open Exploration › Collectors to see which ones buy them. You can sell a whole set at once, and the card stays recorded in your collection. Pawn shop Area Note Vice City Pawn Crosstown, Vice City Buys cards, doubloons and meteorites. Also a fence. Trophies and 100% Don't Touch My Deck : complete 3 sets. For 100% (and the A Long Road trophy) you need 15 of the 18 sets, which means at least 372 cards depending on which ones you pick. The 12- and 18-card sets (Backyard Wrestling and Delights Dancers) are the quickest to finish. More collectibles in the collectibles guide .

titulo: GTA 6 Treasure: Shipwrecks, Metal Detector and How to Sell It
texto: Home › Collectibles › Treasure GTA 6 treasure Shipwreck diving for Kenton, the metal detector and where to sell what you find. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? How to get treasure in GTA 6: diving for Kenton, the metal detector, the 7 shipwreck sets, underwater treasure and where to sell it. Quick answer Treasure is recovered by diving on shipwrecks around the Leonida Keys with a metal detector . It opens with Kenton Rees's Island Dreams mission (Chapter 1) in Key Lento. There are 7 shipwreck treasure sets : 100% needs 5, and This Was No Boat Accident pops when Kenton's strand is done. It's one of the best early money makers: no shooting and no cops. How to unlock it Play the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams : Jason takes a bachelor party diving on a wreck and finds three treasures with the detector. It pays $400. Afterwards Kenton texts you to come back to his shop (green KR icon in Key Lento). He gives you scuba gear and the metal detector and lets you use his boat any time. Dive sites show on the map as a purple chest . Note: Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 and returns between Chapters 2 and 3. Calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can bring him back sooner. How to use the metal detector Take the boat to the purple chest and jump in: the scuba gear goes on automatically in the water. Open the inventory with L1/LB and pick the detector with the right stick. Aim with L2/LT or R2/RT and follow the signal: the light goes from red to green when you're close. When it beeps green constantly, move in and dig the treasure up (a chest icon appears). The detector points to one treasure at a time; don't leave the wreck until you have them all. Treasure types Type Total For 100% Shipwreck treasure sets (Kenton) 7 5 Underwater treasure 85 — Black Hole wrecks 11 — Underwater discoveries 33 33 Underwater discoveries need all 7 of Kenton's sets. See everything else you can collect in the collectibles guide . Where to sell treasure Shipwreck treasure goes to Kenton : sell each set when it's done and the next one opens. Doubloons are bought by Vice City Pawn (which also takes cards and meteorites). Pawn shop list in the cards guide . More ways to earn in the money guide . Tips Start as early as you can: it's risk-free money from Chapter 1. Dive in daylight: visibility is much better underwater. Sweep slowly with the detector: the signal is directional. Watch your oxygen and surface before it runs out. Study fish while you swim: they count toward the 100 animals for 100%. Track it under Progress › Characters › Kenton Rees. titulo: Can You Have Sex in GTA 6? Jason, Lucia, Prostitutes and Strip Clubs
texto: Home › Complete guide › Can you have sex? Can you have sex in GTA 6? Everything about sex in GTA 6: with whom, how to unlock it, which mission has it and what changed from GTA 5. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Yes, you can have sex in GTA 6, but only between Jason and Lucia: how to unlock it, which mission has a scene, why prostitutes are gone and what you can do at strip clubs. Short answer Yes , but only between Jason and Lucia . There are no other partners and no dating other characters. To do it whenever you want you need the relationship maxed: Hot Together (level 4 of 4). See the relationship guide . There's a scripted scene in Coming Home (Chapter 1), when Lucia gets out of prison. Prostitutes are gone : Rockstar removed them for the first time since GTA III. At strip clubs you can pay for a private dance ($300) and tip, but it doesn't go further. How to do it with Lucia (or Jason), step by step Raise the relationship. Jason and Lucia's relationship has 4 levels: Running On Empty, Not So Hot, Crazy In Love and Hot Together . The option only unlocks at the last one. What raises it most: greeting, hugging, holding hands (R2/RT while walking), buying food, answering calls and texts, going to the gym, beach or diving together and robbing as a couple. Full guide in the relationship guide . Check your level. It's on the first tab of the pause menu. Each time it goes up a heart with a «+» appears on screen. Find your partner. With the character you control, walk up to Jason or Lucia (home is easiest). Pick the option with two hearts. When you get close the interaction menu appears; the option marked with two hearts starts the intimate scene. Watch the scene. It's optional and the camera cuts away at the key moment (it happens off-screen). It can't be triggered at any time: if the option doesn't show, you're not at Hot Together yet or the moment doesn't allow it (for example, during a mission). Keep the relationship up. The level also drops if you ignore your partner or spend a lot of time apart; if it falls below Hot Together, the option disappears until you raise it again. Which missions have a sex scene? Coming Home (Chapter 1, mission 13): when Lucia gets out of prison and they go back to Jason's house, there's a scripted intimate scene. It always happens, regardless of the relationship level or earlier choices. Beyond that, the story has other couple scenes between Jason and Lucia, always in cutscenes and without showing genitals. The relationship level changes their tone: at Hot Together they're steamier and the couple can spend the night together in the bedroom; at Running On Empty there's no flirting or intimacy. To reach Coming Home with a high relationship, prepare the house first: buy groceries, flowers and the necklace, and pick up Lucia's clothes in the Chapter 1 optional missions (details in the relationship guide ). Are there prostitutes in GTA 6? No. Rockstar confirmed you can no longer hire prostitutes in GTA 6, a feature that existed since GTA III. It doesn't matter whether you play as Jason or Lucia, roam at night or progress the story: it never unlocks. The reason: the game centers on Jason and Lucia as a couple, and Rockstar chose which features returned based on whether they fit their story. There are no booty calls or side relationships either; some characters flirt with Jason in missions, but nothing more happens. Strip clubs: what you can do Service Price What happens Private dance $300 Greet a dancer and choose «Private dance»; you go to a separate room. Tip $50 each During the dance you can tip several times and each tip unlocks more interaction. Drinks Varies Order them at the bar. You can't have sex with the dancers or take them home (you could in GTA 5). Jason or Lucia can go alone, or both together. There are 3 clubs: NINE1NINE, Jack of Hearts and Delights Cabaret. Locations in strip club locations and guide in strip clubs . The dancers have their own card sets (Delights, Jack of Hearts and Nine1Nine). Nudity and age ratings There's nudity in the background of some missions and at a nudist resort southwest of Jason's house, reachable on foot. You can't roam Leonida naked: the most you can strip to is underwear. Jason is shown nude from behind in a shower scene (in Japan he wears a black thong). Ratings: M (17+) in North America with Nudity and Strong Sexual Content; PEGI 18 in Europe; R18+ in Australia and New Zealand; Z (18+) in Japan. FAQ Can you have sex with other characters? No. The only couple is Jason and Lucia; there's no dating or relationships with other characters. Can you have sex with strip club dancers? No. Only private dances with tips. How many times can you do it? As often as you like while the relationship is at Hot Together and the moment allows it. Is there any benefit? It helps keep the relationship high, which changes the tone of story scenes. Why doesn't the option show up? You're not at Hot Together yet, or you're in the middle of a mission. Check the level in the pause menu and keep doing things together. Will prostitutes come back in an update? Rockstar hasn't said anything. For now they don't exist in the game. titulo: Getting started: Complete guide in GTA 6 | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › Complete guide › Getting started Getting started in GTA 6: step-by-step guide What to do from minute one, how the game works and what not to miss on your first playthrough. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? The essentials in 30 seconds Story: a prologue and 5 chapters, 124 missions and about 60–80 hours. After the ending you stay in the open world. Two protagonists: Jason and Lucia. At first the story decides who you control; from Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can switch freely. Map icons: pink icon with black letters = main mission; black icon with pink letters = optional; purple = side tasks and characters. Saving: 15 manual slots and 1 autosave. There is no mission replay and no per-mission medals. Money: cash in your pocket is lost when you die; deposit it at ATMs (BuckMe app). Cheats: they only work after the story and they disable trophies and saving. Step by step for your first playthrough Prologue (Lucia). Follow the prompts; the final arrest is mandatory. It teaches movement, robberies and getaways. Gone Fishing (Jason). Practice stealth and shoot arms and legs: that pushes your criminal profile toward “professional”. Grab the optional cash in the trailer. Buy your first long gun. In Gear Up pick the shotgun: it is the most useful early on and usually the only one you can afford. Open your BuckMe account. In Buck Me you get $100; from then on deposit your cash at ATMs often. Do the optional Coming Home errands. Groceries, flowers, the necklace, the haircut and Lucia’s clothes improve the relationship, and the necklace is used in Chapter 2. Meditate on Lucia’s terrace. After Down to Earth , come back in the morning and accept her invitation: it is the first meditation spot and it can be missed. Finish Chapter 1 optional content before Recalibration. Shirley, Kenton and Cal pause or become missable; save manually and keep at least $5,000 in savings, because afterwards you lose your cash and the house. Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn. As Lucia, unlock Moses: selling untracked cars is the fastest early money. Raise $15,000 to move to Vice City. Thrillbillies, pawn shop robberies, Kingpin Bowling and Afternoon Delight are the best sources. From Chapter 3, mix story and open world. Scan vehicles with WAiNK, study animals, rob stores and start Randy, Kenton and Bret as soon as they appear: it all counts toward 100%. Core systems worth understanding Health and healing Zombix is the healing item: you can carry up to 5 and it is sold at convenience stores. Eating, working out and sleeping also affect the characters’ stats. Criminal profile The way you act is tracked: stealth and limb shots move your profile toward “professional” or “hardened”; needless killing pushes it to “psychopath”, and killing police or civilians can leave it at “irredeemable”, with far more aggressive police. Recognition and police If the police are looking for you, leave the search area or hide crouched in dark spots. Respraying your car at a Pay 'n' Spray and changing clothes lowers how recognizable you are. Phone and apps WAiNK (D-pad up): scan vehicles, landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. BuckMe : bank, savings and ATM Finder. Police scanner : earned in Unwanted Attention. Scooter Bros : register vehicles (after Moses). Vice City Real Estate : buy garages (after Daily Driver). Fences Fences buy stolen goods: narcotics, jewelry, marked bills and cars. Brian is the first; later come Dunk, Moses, Randy, Yasmani and Tyrone. They show up with a green icon on the map. Missable content Shirley’s missions (Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter): only until Tourist Trap. Donnie’s H&L .38 revolver: open the trunk before destroying the car in Don Gone. Balcony meditation with Lucia: Chapter 1 only. Dubious Provenance parts 2 and 3: if you don’t trust Halifax, they are lost at the end of Chapter 3. Race Against Yago and This is a Free Call From… : they are time-limited (hourglass icon). Cash and the Key Lento house: lost after Recalibration; the motel, after Checking Out. Common beginner mistakes Carrying lots of cash and dying: deposit it as soon as you can. Not saving before a point of no return: there is no way to replay missions. Selling Moses cars stolen near his garage: he rejects them. Using cheats on your main save: they block trophies and saving. Ignoring the open world until the end: scanning and studying as you go saves many hours for 100%. titulo: How to win over Lucia in GTA 6: relationship levels
texto: Home › Complete guide › Relationship with Lucia How to win over Lucia in GTA 6 The 4 levels of Jason and Lucia's relationship, what raises it, what lowers it and what you get. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? The short answer Spend time with Lucia outside missions: greet her, hold hands, buy her food, answer her calls and do things together, robberies included. Every time the relationship goes up, a heart with a '+' appears on screen. What hurts it most is ignoring her and spending long stretches apart. The 4 relationship levels Level What happens 4/4 · Hot Together The top level. Scenes get steamier and they can spend the night together in their bedroom. 3/4 · Crazy In Love Lots of flirting and more time together. 2/4 · Not So Hot Things get awkward and more platonic. 1/4 · Running On Empty The lowest level: no flirting or intimacy in scenes. They don't break up; they stay partners in crime. The level rises and falls throughout the story depending on how you play; it isn't tied to missions. You can check it on the first tab of the pause menu, and the partner menu (on the D-pad) is where you interact with her. What raises the relationship Greet her every time you meet up. Show affection: hold L2/LT and press Circle/B to hug or kiss. Hold hands: hold R2/RT while walking together. Pay for food or drinks at bars and restaurants. Answer her calls and texts , and message her when you're apart. Do activities together: gym, beach, zoo, scuba diving, kayaking, pool, mini golf and sports. Rob together: stores, banks and jobs as a pair count too. Say yes when she wants to hang out at home, even for a few seconds or going to bed: the boost is instant. Check in after something big , like a major job or a chase. Paint the bedroom and fix up the house. Get the house ready before she's out (Chapter 1) For the first hours you only play as Jason. Use them to prepare her return: what you do here raises the relationship before Lucia gets out of prison. Fix up the house Brian lets Jason use and buy groceries. Feng Shui: pick up Lucia's clothes from Andy before heading home. Feng Shui: buy her a necklace (an optional errand before Coming Home). Coming Home: dance with Lucia at the bar; it can raise the relationship several times. Coming Home: during the pool game, defend her from the Aviators to earn a heart. What lowers the relationship Ignoring her calls and texts. Spending long stretches apart. Abandoning her while you're out together. Hurting her. Making the wrong choices in some scenes. Neglect can cost you options like holding hands or kissing, but they come back once you spend time together again. Strip clubs don't raise or lower it. Rewards for a strong relationship Golden Hour: holding hands for 4 hours in total unlocks this filter with a golden tint and widescreen bars. Dollhouse: spending 8 hours with your partner unlocks this filter. Videotape: complete 50 activities with your partner. Faded Glory: rob 50 stores with your partner. The relationship also shapes how the story plays out. See how to activate them in the cheats list . Tips to win Lucia over Play as both. Switch to Lucia now and then and look after Jason too: both sides count. Do the small actions every time you're together: greeting, holding hands and treating her to food. If she suggests something pricey, pay for it: it's one of the biggest boosts. Go on dates: beach walks, the zoo, scuba diving or kayaking. Before a long job, top up the relationship with small gestures so a bad outcome hurts less. Can you have sex in GTA 6? How Hot Together unlocks the intimate scene.

titulo: How to lose the cops in GTA 6: stars, heat and tips
texto: Home › Complete guide › How to lose the cops How to lose the cops in GTA 6 The 6 stars, heat and red icons explained, with the steps to shake off the police. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? 30-second summary 1. Break line of sight: alleys, tunnels, parking garages or duck into a building. 2. Leave the red search area shown on the map. 3. Change what the police know about you: clothes, car, weapon, or split Jason and Lucia up. If you keep the same description, you can be recognized again even after the chase ends. How wanted stars work in GTA 6 GTA 6 has 6 stars (one more than GTA V). Police only respond when a crime is reported: a witness, an alarm or a stolen car's tracker. And they don't chase a dot on the map, they hunt a description of you. State What it looks like What to do Cops responding Crime reported notice Flee before they arrive: it's your best chance to get away clean. Suspect unknown Hollow stars They don't know who you are. Leave without drawing attention. In pursuit Solid white stars They can see you and know who you are. Break line of sight and slow them down by shooting tires, not to kill. Visual lost Flashing stars They're searching your last known location. Hide and keep moving out of the radius. Heat Red stars and a red zone on the map You escaped, but they're still looking for your description there. Change it or stay away. The red icons and how to clear them Icons under your stars show what the police know. Each one clears separately, and a single match is enough to get you recognized. Icon What they know How to clear it Person Your face and looks Wear a mask, cap or sunglasses (L1/LB for accessories) or get a new haircut at a barber. Clothes hanger Your outfit Change your whole outfit. Keep a spare set in your car's trunk. Car The vehicle you used Respray it at a Pay 'n' Spray or swap it for another. Gun The weapon you used Holster it (L1/LB). Long guns must be dropped or stowed in a trunk. Two people Jason and Lucia were together Split up. Camera Caught on CCTV Destroy the recording; it's usually on a laptop in the back room. Cloud camera Cloud CCTV footage Can't be deleted. Clear the other icons and leave the area. Blood on your clothes and exploded dye packs also give you away. Shower at your safehouse to wash off blood. How to lose the cops step by step Break line of sight: take narrow streets, go behind buildings, through alleys, underpasses or underground parking. If a helicopter is on you, a tunnel helps. Use quiet roads: less traffic means fewer crashes and less chance of getting boxed in. Watch the lights at the edge of the screen: they show where the police are coming from. Steer away to avoid roadblocks. Use Focus: cops no longer appear on the minimap; Focus helps you track them. Hide: your player arrow tells you when you're hidden. Bushes, woods, ladders, unlocked doors, or duck down in a stopped car (hold Circle/B). Leave the red zone and don't go back while you still match the description. Change your description: clothes, car, weapon and split the couple until no icons remain. At 1 or 2 stars, staying out of sight for a short while is usually enough. From 3 stars, actively escaping works better. Before, during and after a job Before Keep a spare outfit in the trunk. Put your mask on before going in. Check for patrols, cameras and witnesses. Deposit your cash at an ATM: if you die or get arrested, you lose it. During Disable alarms if you can and don't shoot display cases. Stop anyone calling the police. Destroy the CCTV recording. Aim without firing: people often flee without a fight and the wanted level stays low. After Break line of sight and hide. Ditch the getaway car, especially modern ones (they may have trackers). Use an older car you can hotwire. Leave the red zone, change everything, take off the mask and stow your weapon in the trunk. Stay away from the hot area until the heat fades. Pay 'n' Spray A respray at a Pay 'n' Spray clears the vehicle recognized icon. Note that some shops refuse cars depending on the tracker installed. If yours is refused, swap cars. What you lose if you die or get busted Lost: the cash you're carrying, a small BuckMe fee, weapons you don't own and most likely any loot bags you had. Kept: your owned weapons, from your personal vehicle's trunk or an Ammu-Nation locker. Tip: deposit cash at an ATM before any risky job. Free weapons from police cars (and how to get away with it) Parked police cars carry weapons in the trunk. Find one with no officers nearby and as secluded as possible, put on a mask, cap and sunglasses, pick the trunk (the alarm goes off), grab the weapons and run. You can get long guns, a handgun or body armor. Stow them in your car and use the steps above to lose the wanted level. What changes at high wanted levels Helicopters and K9 units join. Dogs track you relentlessly: keep moving. At 3 stars or more, escaping in a regular car is very hard; a motorcycle or running through alleys works better. Officers follow you onto rooftops if they saw where you went. They try non-lethal takedowns first; shoot back and they turn lethal. Shooting at helicopters can make them pull back. Killing cops escalates the response and pushes your criminal profile toward Violent. At 6 stars, the search zone can cover the whole map. More about the system in combat, police and heists . For the car buttons, see vehicle controls .

titulo: How to make money in GTA 6: the best methods
texto: Home › Complete guide › How to make money How to make money in GTA 6 The best methods by stage of the game, how much they pay and how not to lose what you earn. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? How money works The loop is: steal → escape → sell to a fence → get cash → deposit → spend or save . Pocket cash is lost when you die; money in BuckMe is not. Checking starts with a $15,000 limit that rises with your savings goals, up to $2 million. Purchases over $1,000 are paid through BuckMe. Savings can’t be withdrawn, but they unlock discounts: 20% off RydeMe ($10,000), 20% off garages ($100,000) and 10% off liveries ($500,000, Premium account). Early game (Chapters 1 and 2) Selling cars to Moses: from the Moses mission on. Steal untracked cars far from his garage and bring them in. It is the fastest early method. Mugging pedestrians and robbing registers: small per hit, but instant. Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Billy): good payouts in Port Gellhorn. Hit Avery Pawn and Hit Kingpin Bowling : optional Chapter 2 robberies; at the bowling alley bring sticky bombs and take all 3 valuables. Impounded Vehicle and Veteran Hunted (Jason only): extra options to reach the $15,000 for Prepare for Vice City. Afternoon Delight: $10,000 in one go. Fast money in Chapter 1 (the Keys) While you play as Jason in the Keys, these methods pay best for the least risk: Method Where / when Approx. payout Kenton's treasure dives Purple chest icons off the Keys, after the Island Dreams mission. Use a boat and scuba gear; the detector light turns green over treasure. About $1,400 for the first wreck and up to $4,000 later Exploding boats at sea Random event off the Keys coast. Look for the beeping packages; watch out for sharks. $1,500 to $2,000 in packages Crashed smuggler plane Visible from the long bridge toward Hamlet; it goes down in the Grassrivers. Beat the pilot and grab the product before it blows up. A bag of product to sell at Brian's lockup Kingfisher hideouts Yellow robbery icons in the Grassrivers and islands; Donnie tips you off. Arrive by boat and bank your cash first. Cash, drugs, jewelry and marked bills The parrot stash (Shirley's rum) Back room of Three Sheets Liquor. Missable. Over $1,300 Lab Fees errand Find the note with code 0420 to open the boutique's back room. Cash and product Store robberies Almost any shop, bar, diner or gas station. Destroy the footage and change clothes afterward. A few hundred per store Mugging Anyone on the street. $100 to $200 Who to sell to: Brian's lockup opens with code 7700 (you visit it in Lab Fees) and takes drugs, jewelry and marked bills; Brian pays later, so check Jason's mailbox. Donnie pays more for product from his own lost packages. In Chapter 2, Moses buys untracked cars (about $1,000 to $2,000 each, with roughly a 2-minute cooldown): scan them with your phone before bringing them in. How not to lose what you earn If you die or get busted , you lose the cash you carry and weapons you don't own. Floor stash: Jason's bedroom has a box under the floorboards where you can deposit and withdraw any time. Mailbox: mission pay and fence money often arrive there. Check it whenever you leave home. BuckMe: unlocks with mission 12 of Chapter 1; after that, deposit at any ATM. Shops take up to $999 in cash. Watch the chapter change: Chapter 1 cash doesn't carry into Chapter 2; only BuckMe savings do. Save your first $5,000 early. Hidden loot worth grabbing The criminals' warehouse (South Vice-Dale County, east of Hamlet): take out the criminals, grab the bag on the table (over $6,000), open the safe inside and loot the vans. About $10,000 in total, plus drugs and an exclusive card. Take it home before taking risks. Sell your cards : at pawn shops like Vice City Pawn, in the collectible cards tab. Some are worth $2,700 and selling them doesn't remove your collection progress. Free weapons: parked police cars have weapons in the trunk, so you can skip Ammu-Nation. See how to do it without getting caught . More money secrets in easter eggs . In Vice City (Chapter 3 onward) Banks: 14 small and 8 large with a vault (vaults open after the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…). Payday loans: 7, with a teller and a back safe. Smash 'n' Grabs: 35 between jewelry stores and pawn shops; the back safe pays more. Gang operations: 39 across 9 gangs; they give narcotics, jewelry and watches. Armored trucks: Yasmani sells security van tips. Randy's Wish List: 16 sports cars to order with the Key Cloner; it covers the $200,000 vehicles-sold goal. Stores: 72 convenience stores, 14 liquor stores and 23 fast food places to rob. Fences: who to sell to Brian (Key Lento): narcotics and Chapter 1 loot. Dunk (Port Gellhorn): from Slam Dunk on. Moses (Port Gellhorn): untracked cars. Randy (Balsero): luxury cars. Yasmani (Little Cuba): jewelry and marked bills; he pays best for laundering. Tyrone (La Perle): product from the Kitty Litter labs. Collectible cards sell at pawn shops for $20 to over $1,000, without losing collection progress. Cocaine from Cocaine Flamingos also sells to fences. Missions that pay well Mission Chapter Payout Afternoon Delight Chapter 2 $10,000 (BuckMe, the next day) Slam Dunk Chapter 2 $1,700 + about $1,000 from Dr. Bill’s body Daily Driver Chapter 2 $1,250 + $500 for good condition Donnie's Lost Drugs Chapter 1 $1,200 when sold to Brian Clean Up After Donnie Chapter 1 $600 Lab Fees Chapter 1 $600 Island Dreams Chapter 1 $400 Dubious Provenance Chapter 3 About $2,500 in jewelry and cash Unwanted Attention Chapter 1 $150 What’s worth buying The 8 Vice City Real Estate garages (about $160,000) to store and register cars. Long guns and ammo at Ammu-Nation; only the 6 Expanded stores sell sniper rifles and rocket launchers. Mod shop upgrades; spending on guns, mods and tattoos is the fastest route to the Treat Yo Self trophy ($100,000). A gym membership to raise Strength and Cardio. BuckMe savings goals for their permanent discounts. titulo: Tips and strategies: Complete guide in GTA 6 | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › Complete guide › Tips and strategies GTA 6 tips and strategies Combat, police, robberies, vehicles, partner play and saving: practical tricks to play better. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Combat Combat Focus (LT + RT): slows the action and marks weak points. Use it on groups; with an assault rifle you can drop 5 enemies in a single use. Cover (RB): move from cover to cover and don’t expose yourself while reloading. Melee: block when the enemy rolls their shoulder; counter right after the block. Limbs: shooting arms and legs incapacitates without killing and improves your criminal profile. In vehicles: aim with L1, shoot with R1 and press L3 + R3 for slow motion. Healing: always carry 5 Zombix and armor before heists or gang operations. Police and wanted level When you see the search area, get out of it as fast as you can; crouching in shadows helps you stay unseen. Dirt roads and shortcuts are better than highways for losing patrols. Vault robberies give 4 stars; the tunnel north of Ambrosia is a good escape route. Respray your car at a Pay 'n' Spray and change clothes to lower recognition. In Vice City they accept cars with a standard tracker. Shooting out police tires ends long chases. If your profile is very violent, police will be more aggressive: play smart. Robberies and heists Stores: threaten, take the register and leave. In the Breakfast Run robberies each shop has 1 minute. Partner robberies: three stores in a row without losing your stars earn the Retail Therapy trophy. Silent jewelry jobs: with the Snap Gun (Yasmani’s jobs, Chapter 3) go in through the back door; the safe code is in the back room. Banks and payday loans: the Dye Pack Jammer (Credit Check) keeps bills from getting stained; then you launder them with fences. Gang operations: take every key valuable; they often hide luxury watches. Armored trucks: they can be opened with sticky bombs; get away fast. Vehicles Scan everything you see with WAiNK (D-pad up): it counts for the encyclopedia and 100%. Trackers can be none, standard or advanced. Only sell untracked cars to Moses. To register a car as personal, respray it first; each garage has limited slots. The Slim Jim opens cars without breaking windows and the Key Cloner is for Randy’s jobs. To uncover the map quickly, nothing beats a plane. Partner play D-pad down opens the partner menu: commands, handing over items and more. Switching characters is instant when they are together; apart it takes a few seconds. Errands and choices in missions like Coming Home or Day Release improve the relationship. Working out together at the gym raises both characters’ Strength at once (Personal Best trophy). Exploration and activities Use the binoculars to study animals: you need 100 for 100%. There are 18 meditation spots: they count toward a trophy and toward 100% (15 of 18). Collectible cards sit on walls and tables indoors and in yellow phone boxes or tool boxes outdoors. Cocaine Flamingos (black-and-white bill) drop cocaine you can sell. Under the Bridge stunts are the quickest to complete. Saving and planning Save manually at the start of every chapter and before Recalibration, Checking Out and the final mission. Keep a separate save slot before trying cheats. Deposit before any dangerous mission: pocket cash is lost on death. If a mission breaks (for example dying on the bike in Checking Out), restart it from the menu. titulo: How to turn on headlights in GTA 6 (and high beams)
texto: Home › Complete guide › Vehicle controls GTA 6 vehicle controls: headlights, high beams and signals How to turn on the lights, use high beams and everything else in the car on PS5 and Xbox. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Quick answers Turn on the headlights: press Circle (PS5) or B (Xbox) while in the car. High beams, automatic lights or lights off: hold D-pad left to open the vehicle menu and go to Headlights . Turn signals: tap D-pad left or right . They switch off on their own after the turn. Driving controls Action PS5 Xbox Accelerate R2 RT Brake / reverse L2 LT Steer Left stick Left stick Headlights Circle B Get out Triangle Y Get out with the engine running Double-tap Triangle Double-tap Y Left / right turn signal Quick tap ← / → Quick tap ← / → Vehicle and radio menu Hold ← Hold ← Change station (menu open) L1 / R1 LB / RB Turn the radio off Double-tap ← Double-tap ← Camera options Hold ↓ Hold ↓ These are the Default scheme controls. In the Classic scheme headlights move to Square / X ; accelerate and brake stay on the triggers in every scheme. How to turn on the headlights and high beams Quick shortcut: in the car, press Circle (PS5) or B (Xbox) to switch the lights on and cycle them. High beams, automatic or off: hold D-pad left to open the vehicle menu. Push the right stick up to move from the radio to the car options, open Headlights and choose Normal , Full beam , Automatic or Off . Automatic mode: the car turns its lights on and off based on time of day and weather. The easiest option if you don't want to manage them. Hiding trick: with the car stopped, hold Circle / B and your character ducks down in the seat. Handy for staying out of sight of the police. Turn signals and hazard lights Left signal: a quick tap on D-pad left . Right: a quick tap on D-pad right . They turn off on their own once you finish the turn; tap the same direction again to cancel early. Keep the tap short: holding it opens the radio and vehicle menu. Hazard lights: hold D-pad left , push the right stick up, move with R1 / RB to Hazards and confirm with X / A . If the icon doesn't change, close and reopen the menu: it's usually just a visual glitch. Everything in the vehicle menu Open it by holding D-pad left . The radio shows first; push the right stick up for the car options. Headlights: normal, full beam, automatic or off. Hazards (both signals at once). Windows: roll them up or down. Radio: change stations with L1/R1 or LB/RB . You can also listen to the radio on foot through your phone. Useful driving tips Leave the engine running (double-tap Triangle / Y) when you need to get in and out fast, like during a robbery. Police cars: click the left stick to turn on the siren; hold it to sound the horn. Nitrous: in Settings › Controls you can choose whether nitrous is held or tapped. Tracked cars: modern cars may have a tracker, which makes them easy for the police to find. Older cars can be hotwired and are better getaway cars. Luxury cars: you need to clone their electronic key before you can take them. Boats, planes and helicopters Action PS5 Xbox Boat: accelerate / brake R2 / L2 RT / LT Boat: sharper turn Hold X Hold A Plane: rudder left / right Hold Square / Circle Hold X / B Plane: accelerate R2 RT Plane: slow down on approach Hold L2 Hold LT Plane: landing gear L3 Left stick click Seaplane: take off from water Triangle Y The left stick pitches the nose and is inverted by default. Change it in Settings › Controller › Inverted Controls (aircraft movement). Useful driving settings Control schemes: Default, Classic and Left-Handed (Settings › Controller). Vehicle shooting assist and automatic holster in vehicles are in Settings › Controls. Adaptive Speed Limiter (PS5): on by default; turn it off if the trigger feels like it's holding the car back. Camera follow speed while driving: Settings › Camera › Land & Water Vehicles. You can map the touchpad (PS5) or View button (Xbox) to the camera in Settings › Controller. Kilometers instead of miles: Settings › User Interface › Units of Measurement › Metric. In the same menu you can switch weight to kilograms, temperature to Celsius and the clock to 24-hour. Police on your tail? See how to lose the cops in GTA 6 . Every other button is in controls and settings .

titulo: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: every secret and where to find it
texto: Home › Easter eggs GTA 6 easter eggs and how to find them 36 secrets, references and hidden encounters in Leonida, with their location and the steps to trigger them. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Every GTA 6 easter egg the community has found so far: the tower egg, Bigfoot, the UFO, Dexter and more, with where they are and how to trigger them. These are the easter eggs players have found in Leonida since launch. Each one lists where it is, what to do and what happens. Rockstar doesn't publish an official list, so we'll keep adding more as they turn up. Map secrets Hidden characters and encounters References to other games Mysteries and creatures (6) A literal Easter egg (radio tower) Rockstar took the term literally: at the top of the tallest radio tower, the one visible since the first trailer, there is a giant nest full of painted eggs. Where: Southern Vice-Dale County, west of Southside and Peacock Bay and north of Hamlet. How: Reach the base of the tower and climb the ladders and platforms. The climb takes 6 to 7 minutes. At the top, pick up one of the eggs. What happens: Keep it or throw it off the edge: throwing it plays a short scene where the egg smashes on the windshield of a real estate agent arguing on the phone. You can also BASE jump from the same platform. Official Bigfoot: the swamp Skunk Ape GTA 6's Bigfoot is the Skunk Ape, Florida's take on the legend: a tall, hairy creature wrapped in a green haze. A Weazel News report on the TV in Jason's house already mentions it. Where: Grassrivers, mostly on the road along the east side of Cottonmouth Lake toward Gambit Bay (there are also sightings in the swamps of southern Mariana County). How: Listen for a loud roar and follow the trail with your tracking ability. It leads to a human-shaped tree (its effigy). Investigate it. What happens: The smell knocks your character out and you catch a glimpse of the creature. It can't be hurt or caught. A 'Have You Seen Skunk Ape???' poster leads to Kirk, a cryptid hunter with a side mission line to track it down. Official UFO abduction and hidden trophy One of the most searched-for launch secrets: a full abduction that also unlocks a hidden trophy. Where: Dirt road near the Starlet Motel, east of Port Gellhorn (Kelly County). How: After Chapter 1, go at night (ideally after 2:00 a.m. in-game). Look for a roadside car with flickering headlights, an open trunk and clothes scattered around. Follow the blue glow into the trees and go back to the car when the woman asks you to. What happens: You black out and wake up three days later. It unlocks the hidden bronze trophy 'The Truth Is Out There'. Official The Pelican Valley crab lab An abandoned research outpost where failed crab experiments took place. Where: Southwest of the Pelican Valley swamps, just north of the Keys. How: Go inside the lab and solve the puzzle that opens the safe. What happens: Just over $1,000 and the Crabshack VF5 weapon. Some players also report a rare scene with a giant crab; what triggers it is still unclear. Official The Belville UFO house A house packed with UFO and conspiracy nods. A photo of this very house was already hanging in the Lil' Probe Inn bar in GTA San Andreas: The Definitive Edition, the only one on that wall that didn't match a known location. Where: Belville, Leonard County. How: Check the car's trunk and the house's garage. What happens: There's a snake in the trunk, a conspiracy den in the garage and a meteorite you can sell online. Official Mysteries the community is still working on Three leads that point to a Mount Chiliad-style mystery and still have no clear answer. Where: An abandoned research facility that opens with code 2314 on its keypad (its exact location isn't confirmed yet); standing stones and a meteor crater on top of Mount Kalaga; and the Monument of Leonidan Supremacy, north of Port Gellhorn. How: If you find the keypad, enter 2314. For the rest, explore the top of Mount Kalaga and the area around the monument. What happens: So far we only know the code opens the facility. We'll update this as soon as there's more. Unconfirmed Hidden cars (5) Classic Pfister Comet at a luxury mansion A magenta retro Comet with green rims, parked at the driveway of a mansion in Vice City's wealthy area. Where: Vice City's luxury residential islands, in the driveway of a mansion with an enterable interior (usually empty at night). How: Walk onto the property. The keys usually aren't there, so you'll have to steal it; since it's an old car, you can break in with no trouble. What happens: It's yours to drive. Note: it has an advanced tracker, so it's good for a joyride but not for selling or keeping without the police finding it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Imponte Ruiner Turbo with nitrous, next to Jason's house A black muscle car with an exposed engine and factory nitrous, hidden right next to where you start. Where: Next to Jason's house, in Mariana County (the Keys). How: Find the Ruiner Turbo parked at the neighboring house. It's locked and has an alarm, so break in and get away quickly. What happens: The best part: it has no tracker, so you can keep it. The nitrous is strong; brake before corners. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Classic Vapid roadster on the gardeners' island A 1930s teal roadster kept inside the garage of a mansion on a private island. Where: A private island in northern Vice-Dale County, near the Leonard County line. The car is inside the mansion's garage. How: Go in through the back, from the waterfront garden: the front has security and gardeners who will give you away. What happens: It's unlocked with no tracker and no alarm, so you can drive off with no trouble. Official Vapid Hustler (1932): the flame hot rod A black 1932 hot rod with pink flames and an exposed engine, kept in a house garage in Vice City. Where: A house garage in Vice-Dale County (Vice City). How: Go into the garage at night. The catch: two cars are parked in the driveway blocking the exit, so you'll need to squeeze it out or move one. What happens: It has an alarm and a standard tracker: use it for a ride, or deal with the tracker before trying to keep it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official The Scooby-Doo van (Bravado Youga XL 1979) A green and yellow 1979 Youga XL that looks just like Scooby-Doo's Mystery Machine. Where: An alley in downtown Vice City, in Vice-Dale County. How: Head to the alley and get in. It doesn't always spawn: if it isn't there, come back at another time of day. What happens: It has no security and no tracker, so you can keep it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Hidden money and weapons (3) The criminals' warehouse: over $10,000 early on One of the best early-game hauls: an industrial warehouse full of criminals with cash, drugs and an exclusive collectible card. Where: South Vice-Dale County, a little east of Hamlet. It's a lot with a warehouse, trucks and vans. How: Take out the criminals and loot them. On a table there's a bag with over $6,000; grab it. Then search everything: there's a safe inside the building, and the vans have loot too. What happens: About $10,000 in total, plus drugs and a very exclusive collectible card. Load it into your car and take it home to stash it before anything happens. Official Collectible cards worth up to $2,700 The collectible cards you find don't just complete sets: you can sell them, and some are worth a lot. Where: Pawn shops, such as Vice City Pawn. How: Go into the pawn shop, open the collectible cards tab, pick the set (for example, Los Santos Pounders) and sell. What happens: Cards worth $2,700 have turned up. Selling doesn't remove your collection progress, so sell them as you find them. Full collectible cards guide → Official Free weapons from parked police cars Police cars carry weapons in the trunk, and you can keep them. Where: Any parked police car with no officers around; the more secluded the better (a parking lot works well). How: Put on a mask, cap and sunglasses. Park your car behind it, pick the trunk lock (the alarm goes off), grab the weapons and run. Stow them in your car. What happens: You can get two long guns, a handgun, body armor or any mix. If police are nearby, they'll spot you right away. Official Encounters and hidden characters (8) Cool Dog and Dog Island If you get stranded at sea, a dog wearing sunglasses shows up on a jet ski to rescue you. Where: Open sea. Gambit Bay is the easiest spot. How: Take the boat from the dock at Jason's house, head into Gambit Bay, jump in and swim away from the shore. After about 5 minutes alone you'll hear barking. What happens: Cool Dog picks you up and takes you to an island full of dogs. Throw him the ball and follow him around the island to a stash worth about $1,200. Official The talking parrot at Three Sheets Liquor An early-game secret that pays well and can be missed if you progress too far. Where: Back room of the Three Sheets Liquor store. How: Do Shirley's rum errand. Then come back, jump the side fence (don't go behind the counter), beat the thugs and find the caged red parrot. Check the grate in the wall next to the generator. What happens: A stash with more than $1,300. Do it early: the errand is missable. Official The cat in the stolen car Some parked cars have a cat inside. Where: Any parked car with a cat inside. How: Steal the car and drive off. What happens: The cat attacks the driver in a short scene and your character ends up tossing it out the window. Official Camilo and the 'Trunk Challenge' A streamer who climbed into a car trunk for a challenge. Where: Inside the trunk of a stolen car, while playing as Lucia. How: Open the trunk of a car you just stole. What happens: Lucia finds Camilo doing the 'Trunk Challenge', and he keeps talking to his chat throughout the chase. Official The furry rescue Leonida has a 'furry ban' that's satirized in TV ads and in the Vice City Horn newspaper. On the street, you can run into the consequences. Where: By the roadside at night, while playing as Lucia. How: When you see police chasing a man in a fox costume, decide what to do. What happens: Let the cops take him, or break the blockade, free him and help the furries escape. Official The lawsuit witness An absurd random event on the streets of Vice City. Where: Vice City streets. How: Stay close when a truck rear-ends a sedan. What happens: The driver deliberately sets his own legs on fire and asks you to be a witness in his lawsuit against the truck company. Official William Tell target practice An encounter in the middle of nowhere. Where: Rural areas; you notice it by the gunfire in the distance. How: Go toward the sound of gunfire. What happens: Two men invite you to shoot objects one of them holds above his head. Aim carefully: hitting his hand changes how it ends. Official The dumpster lawyer A man who lives in a dumpster and gives legal advice. Where: Leonida streets, next to a dumpster. How: Talk to him when you find him. What happens: He offers legal advice and you choose whether to pay him in pills. Official References to other games and shows (8) Dexter Morgan's apartment The building where Dexter lived in the TV series is recreated in Vice City, along with his boat. Where: Washington Island, in eastern Vice City, between the Pay 'n' Spray and Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icons. Look for a small light-blue building with a cylindrical staircase on its south side. How: Go up to the second floor and head to the corner unit at the end of the walkway. What happens: The door is locked, but the 'Slice of Life' boat is at the dock next door. If you dive nearby, there are trash bags on the sea floor just like in the show. Official Paul Walker's green Eclipse A Fast & Furious tribute: the green Maibatsu Penumbra FF, based on the Mitsubishi Eclipse from the movie. Where: A villa garage on Vespucci Island, near Vice Beach. How: Get into the villa, break through to the garage, smash the car window and hotwire it. What happens: The car is yours. Open the trunk: there's a snake waiting for you. Official The boat with a Los Santos GPS A GTA V nod right at home. Where: The boat in the yard of Jason's house. How: Check the boat's GPS screen. What happens: It shows the map of Los Santos. Official Michael's ringtone You can use the same ringtone Michael De Santa had in GTA V. Where: Phone › Settings › Ringtone. How: Pick the 'Wind Chimes' ringtone. What happens: Your phone rings just like Michael's. Official The New Austin cowboy novel A reminder that Red Dead Redemption and GTA share a universe. Where: Several places; one copy is in Jacob's Tavern, in Millport. How: Read the Western novel you find. What happens: It tells the story of a cowboy in New Austin, the Red Dead Redemption region. Cars with New Austin license plates have also been spotted. Official A Liberty City mobster's memoir A book that ties into the story of GTA IV. Where: Jason's house, on the small table by the back door (Chapter 1). How: Read the book. What happens: It's the memoir of a former Liberty City mobster who mentions events from 2008, the year GTA IV takes place. Official More nods to GTA V, GTA IV and Mount Chiliad Small details spread across Leonida for long-time fans. Where: All over the map. How: Look at magazines, podcasts and decor. What happens: A magazine featuring yoga teacher Fabien LaRouche, a true crime podcast about Floyd and Debra, lawn gnomes, desert postcards, Mr. Raspberry Jam and a truck covered in conspiracy theories with the eye from the Mount Chiliad mural. Official The Cristiano Ronaldo statue at 'Messi's house' A player found a gold statue mimicking Cristiano Ronaldo's celebration at a bayfront mansion facing the Vice City skyline. Since Messi lives in Miami, the community dubbed it 'the CR7 statue in Messi's house'. Where: A mansion with a pool and dock on the Vice City bay. The exact location isn't confirmed yet. How: Search the waterfront mansions with a direct view of downtown Vice City. What happens: It's just a visual nod: the statue stands by the pool. Unconfirmed Fun details (6) Painting the bedroom for Lucia You can pick colors and paint the walls by hand with a roller. Where: Jason's house. How: Choose a color and paint the walls. What happens: It boosts your relationship with Lucia. See the Jason and Lucia relationship guide for more ways to do it. Official Feeding the pet snake Jason keeps a snake at home. Where: Jason's house. How: Feed it. What happens: The snake catches and swallows the mouse with a very realistic animation. Official Petting dogs and cats You can pet the dogs and bodega cats you come across. Where: Anywhere with dogs or cats. How: Walk up and interact. What happens: Careful: sometimes a car door swings open into the dog you're petting. Official JoySystem console and retro arcade There are video games inside the video game. Where: Your living room (JoySystem console) and a retro video game store. How: Use the console on the TV or walk into the store. What happens: The console has mini-games. At the retro store you can buy headphones to listen to music on foot and play a Big Buck Hunter-style hunting arcade game. Official No socks with flip-flops A joke hidden in the clothing menu. Where: Clothing menu. How: Put flip-flops on Jason and try to pick socks. What happens: The socks option shows a padlock. Official Kilometers instead of miles (and a 24-hour clock) The game defaults to miles and pounds, but you can switch to metric. Where: Settings › User Interface (at the very bottom). How: Under Units of Measurement choose Metric. In the same menu you can switch weight to kilograms, temperature to Celsius and the clock to 24-hour format. What happens: The minimap, speedometer and distances show in kilometers. Official You may also need Vehicle controls: lights and high beams How to lose the cops Relationship with Lucia How to make money Radio and songs

What happens: A stash with more than $1,300. Do it early: the errand is missable. Official The cat in the stolen car Some parked cars have a cat inside. Where: Any parked car with a cat inside. How: Steal the car and drive off. What happens: The cat attacks the driver in a short scene and your character ends up tossing it out the window. Official Camilo and the 'Trunk Challenge' A streamer who climbed into a car trunk for a challenge. Where: Inside the trunk of a stolen car, while playing as Lucia. How: Open the trunk of a car you just stole. What happens: Lucia finds Camilo doing the 'Trunk Challenge', and he keeps talking to his chat throughout the chase. Official The furry rescue Leonida has a 'furry ban' that's satirized in TV ads and in the Vice City Horn newspaper. On the street, you can run into the consequences. Where: By the roadside at night, while playing as Lucia. How: When you see police chasing a man in a fox costume, decide what to do. What happens: Let the cops take him, or break the blockade, free him and help the furries escape. Official The lawsuit witness An absurd random event on the streets of Vice City. Where: Vice City streets. How: Stay close when a truck rear-ends a sedan. What happens: The driver deliberately sets his own legs on fire and asks you to be a witness in his lawsuit against the truck company. Official William Tell target practice An encounter in the middle of nowhere. Where: Rural areas; you notice it by the gunfire in the distance. How: Go toward the sound of gunfire. What happens: Two men invite you to shoot objects one of them holds above his head. Aim carefully: hitting his hand changes how it ends. Official The dumpster lawyer A man who lives in a dumpster and gives legal advice. Where: Leonida streets, next to a dumpster. How: Talk to him when you find him. What happens: He offers legal advice and you choose whether to pay him in pills. Official All easter eggs Map secrets References to other games

titulo: GTA 6 map secrets: UFO, tower egg, crab lab and more
texto: Home › Easter eggs › Map secrets GTA 6 map secrets Hidden places in Leonida and how to reach each one. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Mysteries and creatures (5) A literal Easter egg (radio tower) Rockstar took the term literally: at the top of the tallest radio tower, the one visible since the first trailer, there is a giant nest full of painted eggs. Where: Southern Vice-Dale County, west of Southside and Peacock Bay and north of Hamlet. How: Reach the base of the tower and climb the ladders and platforms. The climb takes 6 to 7 minutes. At the top, pick up one of the eggs. What happens: Keep it or throw it off the edge: throwing it plays a short scene where the egg smashes on the windshield of a real estate agent arguing on the phone. You can also BASE jump from the same platform. Official UFO abduction and hidden trophy One of the most searched-for launch secrets: a full abduction that also unlocks a hidden trophy. Where: Dirt road near the Starlet Motel, east of Port Gellhorn (Kelly County). How: After Chapter 1, go at night (ideally after 2:00 a.m. in-game). Look for a roadside car with flickering headlights, an open trunk and clothes scattered around. Follow the blue glow into the trees and go back to the car when the woman asks you to. What happens: You black out and wake up three days later. It unlocks the hidden bronze trophy 'The Truth Is Out There'. Official The Pelican Valley crab lab An abandoned research outpost where failed crab experiments took place. Where: Southwest of the Pelican Valley swamps, just north of the Keys. How: Go inside the lab and solve the puzzle that opens the safe. What happens: Just over $1,000 and the Crabshack VF5 weapon. Some players also report a rare scene with a giant crab; what triggers it is still unclear. Official The Belville UFO house A house packed with UFO and conspiracy nods. A photo of this very house was already hanging in the Lil' Probe Inn bar in GTA San Andreas: The Definitive Edition, the only one on that wall that didn't match a known location. Where: Belville, Leonard County. How: Check the car's trunk and the house's garage. What happens: There's a snake in the trunk, a conspiracy den in the garage and a meteorite you can sell online. Official Mysteries the community is still working on Three leads that point to a Mount Chiliad-style mystery and still have no clear answer. Where: An abandoned research facility that opens with code 2314 on its keypad (its exact location isn't confirmed yet); standing stones and a meteor crater on top of Mount Kalaga; and the Monument of Leonidan Supremacy, north of Port Gellhorn. How: If you find the keypad, enter 2314. For the rest, explore the top of Mount Kalaga and the area around the monument. What happens: So far we only know the code opens the facility. We'll update this as soon as there's more. Unconfirmed Hidden cars (5) Classic Pfister Comet at a luxury mansion A magenta retro Comet with green rims, parked at the driveway of a mansion in Vice City's wealthy area. Where: Vice City's luxury residential islands, in the driveway of a mansion with an enterable interior (usually empty at night). How: Walk onto the property. The keys usually aren't there, so you'll have to steal it; since it's an old car, you can break in with no trouble. What happens: It's yours to drive. Note: it has an advanced tracker, so it's good for a joyride but not for selling or keeping without the police finding it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Imponte Ruiner Turbo with nitrous, next to Jason's house A black muscle car with an exposed engine and factory nitrous, hidden right next to where you start. Where: Next to Jason's house, in Mariana County (the Keys). How: Find the Ruiner Turbo parked at the neighboring house. It's locked and has an alarm, so break in and get away quickly. What happens: The best part: it has no tracker, so you can keep it. The nitrous is strong; brake before corners. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Classic Vapid roadster on the gardeners' island A 1930s teal roadster kept inside the garage of a mansion on a private island. Where: A private island in northern Vice-Dale County, near the Leonard County line. The car is inside the mansion's garage. How: Go in through the back, from the waterfront garden: the front has security and gardeners who will give you away. What happens: It's unlocked with no tracker and no alarm, so you can drive off with no trouble. Official Vapid Hustler (1932): the flame hot rod A black 1932 hot rod with pink flames and an exposed engine, kept in a house garage in Vice City. Where: A house garage in Vice-Dale County (Vice City). How: Go into the garage at night. The catch: two cars are parked in the driveway blocking the exit, so you'll need to squeeze it out or move one. What happens: It has an alarm and a standard tracker: use it for a ride, or deal with the tracker before trying to keep it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official The Scooby-Doo van (Bravado Youga XL 1979) A green and yellow 1979 Youga XL that looks just like Scooby-Doo's Mystery Machine. Where: An alley in downtown Vice City, in Vice-Dale County. How: Head to the alley and get in. It doesn't always spawn: if it isn't there, come back at another time of day. What happens: It has no security and no tracker, so you can keep it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Hidden money and weapons (1) The criminals' warehouse: over $10,000 early on One of the best early-game hauls: an industrial warehouse full of criminals with cash, drugs and an exclusive collectible card. Where: South Vice-Dale County, a little east of Hamlet. It's a lot with a warehouse, trucks and vans. How: Take out the criminals and loot them. On a table there's a bag with over $6,000; grab it. Then search everything: there's a safe inside the building, and the vans have loot too. What happens: About $10,000 in total, plus drugs and a very exclusive collectible card. Load it into your car and take it home to stash it before anything happens. Official Encounters and hidden characters (1) Cool Dog and Dog Island If you get stranded at sea, a dog wearing sunglasses shows up on a jet ski to rescue you. Where: Open sea. Gambit Bay is the easiest spot. How: Take the boat from the dock at Jason's house, head into Gambit Bay, jump in and swim away from the shore. After about 5 minutes alone you'll hear barking. What happens: Cool Dog picks you up and takes you to an island full of dogs. Throw him the ball and follow him around the island to a stash worth about $1,200. Official References to other games and shows (2) Dexter Morgan's apartment The building where Dexter lived in the TV series is recreated in Vice City, along with his boat. Where: Washington Island, in eastern Vice City, between the Pay 'n' Spray and Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icons. Look for a small light-blue building with a cylindrical staircase on its south side. How: Go up to the second floor and head to the corner unit at the end of the walkway. What happens: The door is locked, but the 'Slice of Life' boat is at the dock next door. If you dive nearby, there are trash bags on the sea floor just like in the show. Official Paul Walker's green Eclipse A Fast & Furious tribute: the green Maibatsu Penumbra FF, based on the Mitsubishi Eclipse from the movie. Where: A villa garage on Vespucci Island, near Vice Beach. How: Get into the villa, break through to the garage, smash the car window and hotwire it. What happens: The car is yours. Open the trunk: there's a snake waiting for you. Official All easter eggs Hidden characters and encounters References to other games

What happens: It's the memoir of a former Liberty City mobster who mentions events from 2008, the year GTA IV takes place. Since Messi lives in Miami, the community dubbed it 'the CR7 statue in Messi's house'. Where: A mansion with a pool and dock on the Vice City bay. The exact location isn't confirmed yet. How: Search the waterfront mansions with a direct view of downtown Vice City. What happens: It's just a visual nod: the statue stands by the pool. titulo: Gone Fishing: story mission 2 in GTA 6 | GTA 6 Encyclopedia
texto: Home › Missions › Story missions › Gone Fishing Gone Fishing Story mission 2 · Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Gone Fishing Chapter Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise Mission number 2 of 122 Protagonist Jason Duval A smuggling attempt with Cal and Donnie goes wrong, and Jason has to venture into Kingfishers territory in Pelican Valley. May contain spoilers. Official Mission guide Start: Mariana County · Given by: Cal · Reward: Jason’s house in Key Lento Who plays it: Jason only Objectives Follow the plane and pick up the packages. Look for Donnie at the camp. Find a way into the cabin and untie Donnie. Head to the plane. Board the seaplane. Fly back to Brian’s marina. Step by step 1. Packages at sea. After the opening cutscene, chase Donnie’s plane by boat and slow down near the packages so Cal can fish them out. Then follow the pink line on the minimap to the swamps and use the binoculars (weapon wheel) to watch the deal at the docks: the Kingfishers capture Donnie. 2. Get into the camp. Leave the boat at the nearby docks; Jason goes on alone. You can move in stealth: crouch, approach each enemy from behind, grab them and knock them out. Cross the camp to the cabin at the back, where they are holding Donnie. 3. Untie Donnie. Go in through the front door, avoiding the guard (he walks away after a while), and untie Donnie. A brute arrives: knock him out with your fists and block his punches. Then pick up the Zombix (healing item) and equip a weapon. 4. To the plane. You can now use weapons freely. On the way, the white and red trailer on the left holds your money (Donnie tells you): go in, beat the enemy and take the cash. It is optional and missable, but it adds to your “professional” reputation. 5. Take off. Shoot your way to the seaplane, or run to it and heal with Zombix if needed. 6. Back to the marina. Fly to the pink marker, land on the water by slowing down and drive to the marina. A cutscene introduces Brian, Jason’s boss, and the mission ends. Tips The binoculars are also used to study animals: you need to study 100 of 255 for 100%, and progress during the story already counts. Zombix is the healing item (up to 5; sold at convenience stores). Reputation: shooting limbs incapacitates without killing (“hardened”); full stealth gives “professional”; killing gives “psychopath”, and killing police or civilians can reach “irredeemable” (police may open fire on sight). Lab Fees Chapter Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise Mission number 6 of 122 Protagonist Jason Duval Jason collects Brian’s rent at a gift shop that hides more than souvenirs. May contain spoilers. Official Mission guide Start: Mariana County › Key Lento · Given by: Jason · Requirement: finish Gone Fishing · Reward: $600 Alternate name: Collect Brian’s Rent Who plays it: Jason only Objectives Talk to the clerk. Get into the lab and collect the acid. Call Brian. Store the acid in Brian’s lockup. Step by step 1. The store. Jason goes to a souvenir store that is really the front for an acid lab, to collect Brian’s rent. Use the phone and call Brian; he’ll tell you the clerk doesn’t have the rent money. 2. The lab. Since there’s no money, Jason takes product instead: go into the lab and collect the acid. 3. Call Brian. With the product in hand, call Brian again from the phone. 4. Brian’s lockup. It is marked with a green icon on the map. The door code is 7700 . Inside, leave the acid in the stash to finish. Tip You can sell stolen narcotics, jewelry and marked bills to “fences” like Brian. More fences unlock as the story progresses and show up with a green icon on the map, just like the lockup. Note The lab door code in the store is 0420 .
