The robbery flashback. The talk opens a flashback: Lucia holds up a Payday Loan store. Threaten the teller and clear the button prompts to grab the cash. 3. The escape. Run and get away from the police. The getaway is scripted and goes wrong: head back to the coffee shop the game marks and let them arrest you; it can't be avoided. 4. End of the prologue. After the arrest, baby Tommy is taken by child services and the story cuts to Jason with Gone Fishing. Tips Don't waste time trying to shake the police: the arrest is part of the story. texto: Home › Privacy policy Privacy policy What information we handle when you visit GTA 6 Encyclopedia. What data we collect GTA 6 Encyclopedia has no user accounts or forms, and we do not ask for personal data to browse. We only receive your information if you email us. Technical data The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. As with any web server, GitHub may log technical data about your visit (such as IP address and browser) under its own privacy policy. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser connects to Google servers when a page opens. First-party cookies The site does not set its own tracking cookies. Advertising and affiliate links We may show third-party ads (for example, Google AdSense) and affiliate links to stores. These third parties may use cookies or identifiers to show ads based on your visits to this and other sites. You can manage or turn off Google personalized advertising at adssettings.google.com and learn about more options at aboutads.info . Affiliate links are marked as such. If you buy through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. If you write to us We use your email only to reply. We do not share it or use it to send you advertising. Your rights You can ask us to delete any messages you sent us by writing to contacto@gta6encyclopedia.com . Changes We may update this policy. Last updated: November 17, 2026. Advertising is not currently enabled by this notice The possibility of future monetization does not mean ads are currently active. Before adding an ad network, non-essential analytics or third-party cookies, this policy must be updated to identify the actual providers, purposes, transfers, retention periods and consent mechanisms. Non-essential technologies must not be loaded before consent where applicable law requires it. Controller and contact For privacy inquiries, email contacto@gta6encyclopedia.com. Before enabling forms, comments, analytics or advertising, the site operator should complete this policy with their identity and contact address, along with provider details and the applicable rights-request procedures. Territorial scope Privacy and cookie requirements depend on the country or region from which the site is accessed. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? The Vault Radio Genre Electronic and rave Songs 24 Notes Secret station: unlocked by scanning a poster inside The Vault club. Official About the station The DJ mixes from The Vault, Vice City's home of underground electronic music. It's the 23rd station and it doesn't show up on the radio until you unlock it. How to unlock The Vault Radio Reach Vice City and mark The Vault on the map: it's in the center, south of the Jack of Hearts club and west of NINE1NINE. Go in through the front entrance and look for a red poster with a pink gas mask. Open the WAiNK camera on your phone (D-pad up) and scan the poster with R1 / RB. Done: the station stays unlocked for good, in the car and on your phone. titulo: GTA 6 strip clubs (high heel icon): locations and prices
texto: Home › Locations › Strip clubs GTA 6 strip clubs: the high heel icon Where NINE1NINE, Delights Cabaret and Jack of Hearts are, what a dance costs and how each club works. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? GTA 6 strip clubs 👠: locations, prices, private dances and which club is worth your money. Quick answer There are 3 strip clubs in Leonida: NINE1NINE and Jack of Hearts in Vice City, and Delights Cabaret in Port Gellhorn. On the in-game map they're marked with a high heel icon 👠. Jack of Hearts has its own icon: a heart with a crown. NINE1NINE is the closest at the start, Delights is the cheapest and Jack of Hearts opens through the story. 👠 See them all on the interactive map ("Strip clubs" filter). 📍 See every location and the dancer cards in Strip club locations . Where they are and what they cost Club Area Available Private dance Tip NINE1NINE North Downtown, Vice City (next to The Vault) From the start, any time $300 $50 Delights Cabaret Port Gellhorn, by Interstate 404 From the start, any time $40 $10 ($5 on stage) Jack of Hearts North Crosstown, Vice City Opens through the story (Chapter 3) To be confirmed To be confirmed Prices are the ones reported by the first launch guides. The 3 clubs NINE1NINE Vice City's luxury spot: half nightclub, half strip club, with private VIP lounges. It's the fanciest and the priciest. Where: North Downtown, just south of the big highway interchange and right next to The Vault club. About 5 miles from Jason's house in Key Lento. Inside: Bar, dance floor, private VIP lounges and an ATM. No stage dances. Prices: $300 private dance and $50 tips. Tip: Besides talking to a dancer, you can book a private dance with the person at the VIP lounge entrance. Official Delights Cabaret A run-down roadside cabaret with local talent and several stages. The cheap option with more character. Where: Port Gellhorn (Kelly County), along Interstate 404 on the east side of town near Freedom Tattoo. Look for the red neon sign. Inside: Several stages, a bar, an ATM and a pool table in the middle where you can challenge a local opponent. Prices: $40 private dance, $10 tip and $5 stage tips. Story: In Chapter 2 a story beat takes you there with Vicki, and some staff already recognize Jason. Official Jack of Hearts Boobie Ike's club, a Vice City legend. It's tied to the story and the music scene: the Only Raw Records studio is inside. Where: North end of Crosstown, Vice City, south of Bayside. How to get in: It's locked at first. It opens during Chapter 3, when the story takes you to Boobie and Dre'Quan. Inside: Bar, ATM and the Only Raw Records recording studio. Icon: On the map it isn't a high heel but a heart with a crown. Official How strip clubs work in GTA 6 Bring cash. Dances are paid in cash; every club has an ATM inside if you need it. Greet first. Walk up to a dancer and hold L2 / LT to look at and greet her. Ask for a private dance. Then use the interaction button (hold Triangle / Y ) to pay and go to the private area. Tip during the dance to trigger extra animations. At Delights you can also tip whoever is on stage. Order a drink at the bar with the Order prompt; you can tip the bartender too. At Delights, play pool : there's a local opponent you can challenge. Tips Quickest: NINE1NINE, the closest at the start and open from day one. Cheapest: Delights Cabaret; a private dance is $40 versus $300 at NINE1NINE. With Lucia: visiting a strip club doesn't raise or lower Jason and Lucia's relationship. See what does . Out of money? Use the club's ATM before ordering another dance. GTA 6 is rated M (17+) and these clubs are adult content. Other clubs that aren't strip clubs The Vault: electronic music club next to NINE1NINE. A good place to go dancing with Lucia, and home to the poster that unlocks The Vault Radio . Effluvia: a rooftop bar in Vice City. Rusty Anchor: a bar in the Keys, near where Jason starts.

titulo: GTA 6 hidden cars: locations and how to get them
texto: Home › Vehicles › Hidden cars GTA 6 hidden cars and where to find them Special vehicles hidden in garages and mansions around Leonida, with their location and whether they have an alarm or tracker. Confirmation level Official Unconfirmed What do they mean? Hidden cars in GTA 6 and where to find them: Paul Walker's Eclipse, Scooby-Doo's van and more, with alarm and tracker info. These cars don't show up on the street: they're kept in specific garages, driveways and alleys. Check whether they have an alarm or tracker before stealing them, since that decides whether you can keep them. Some don't always spawn; if it isn't there, come back at another time. Hidden cars (6) Paul Walker's green Eclipse A Fast & Furious tribute: the green Maibatsu Penumbra FF, based on the Mitsubishi Eclipse from the movie. Where: A villa garage on Vespucci Island, near Vice Beach. How: Get into the villa, break through to the garage, smash the car window and hotwire it. What happens: The car is yours. Open the trunk: there's a snake waiting for you. Official Classic Pfister Comet at a luxury mansion A magenta retro Comet with green rims, parked at the driveway of a mansion in Vice City's wealthy area. Where: Vice City's luxury residential islands, in the driveway of a mansion with an enterable interior (usually empty at night). How: Walk onto the property. The keys usually aren't there, so you'll have to steal it; since it's an old car, you can break in with no trouble. What happens: It's yours to drive. Note: it has an advanced tracker, so it's good for a joyride but not for selling or keeping without the police finding it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Imponte Ruiner Turbo with nitrous, next to Jason's house A black muscle car with an exposed engine and factory nitrous, hidden right next to where you start. Where: Next to Jason's house, in Mariana County (the Keys). How: Find the Ruiner Turbo parked at the neighboring house. It's locked and has an alarm, so break in and get away quickly. What happens: The best part: it has no tracker, so you can keep it. The nitrous is strong; brake before corners. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official Classic Vapid roadster on the gardeners' island A 1930s teal roadster kept inside the garage of a mansion on a private island. Where: A private island in northern Vice-Dale County, near the Leonard County line. The car is inside the mansion's garage. How: Go in through the back, from the waterfront garden: the front has security and gardeners who will give you away. What happens: It's unlocked with no tracker and no alarm, so you can drive off with no trouble. Official Vapid Hustler (1932): the flame hot rod A black 1932 hot rod with pink flames and an exposed engine, kept in a house garage in Vice City. Where: A house garage in Vice-Dale County (Vice City). How: Go into the garage at night. The catch: two cars are parked in the driveway blocking the exit, so you'll need to squeeze it out or move one. What happens: It has an alarm and a standard tracker: use it for a ride, or deal with the tracker before trying to keep it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official The Scooby-Doo van (Bravado Youga XL 1979) A green and yellow 1979 Youga XL that looks just like Scooby-Doo's Mystery Machine. Where: An alley in downtown Vice City, in Vice-Dale County. How: Head to the alley and get in. It doesn't always spawn: if it isn't there, come back at another time of day. What happens: It has no security and no tracker, so you can keep it. Vehicle page: See vehicle page Official All easter eggs How to lose the cops Vehicle controls: lights and high beams
